display.purpose: The world heading above the stage; one per page.

name.purpose: Selected resident's name in the sidecar portrait. One of only two Georgia uses.

clock.purpose: Town clock in the masthead, amber, tabular figures. 1.25rem at <=520px, 1.0625rem at <=380px.

title.purpose: Task titles, tools summary and tool sub-headings (550-600).

body-sm.purpose: Controls, chat lines, memories, section notes; default button size.

label.purpose: Hints, footers, need labels, example chips, compact actions.

status.purpose: Connection-mode pill (uppercase, 0.12em) and request status chips (capitalized, 0.04em). Status words only.

data.purpose: Event timestamps, replay time, memory metadata, scenario JSON and output.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating surfaces only: glass rail groups at >=1340px, toast, connection pill. Never paired with a border.

shadows.name: canvas-label
shadows.purpose: Place and resident labels drawn on the town canvas (speech bubbles: .4 / 10 / 3).

shadows.name: stage-light
shadows.purpose: The stage's light pool behind the town; paired with a 45% black edge vignette.

shadows.name: portrait-light
shadows.purpose: Amber pool of light under the resident portrait.

shadows.name: afterglow
shadows.purpose: Behind a request status chip when its state changes; fades out over 1100ms.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default curve: press, tab underline, disclosure chevrons, stage light-up, afterglow.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Defined in :root for on-screen movement; no shipped rule uses it yet.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press: transform scale(0.97). Reduced motion: opacity 0.85, no scale.

motion.name: quick
motion.purpose: Hover overlay opacity (7% currentColor, 12% white on primary); fine pointers only.

motion.name: tab
motion.purpose: Active-tab amber underline scaleX 0 to 1; disclosure chevron rotation.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: Toast opacity and translateY(100%) to 0, visibility delayed on exit. Reduced motion: no translate.

motion.name: light-up
motion.purpose: Signature moment: stage veil opacity 0.92 to 0 and canvas scale 0.97 to 1 with opacity 0.6 to 1, once artwork loads (data-light dim to on). Reduced motion: veil only, 300ms.

motion.name: afterglow
motion.purpose: Request status chip afterglow opacity 1 to 0 on state change (.glow). Reduced motion: 600ms.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Single column (town, resident, requests); scrolling rails; shorter canvas.

breakpoints.name: rails
breakpoints.purpose: Rails float inside the stage as glass.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default control: raised moss, hairline border, overlay hover, press compression.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 13px; font: 550 0.8125rem/1.2 var(--font-ui, system-ui, sans-serif); color: #e7efea; background: #182521; border: 1px solid #23332e; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: currentColor; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn:hover::after { opacity: 0.07; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a85c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one amber action in a region; full-width send in the sidecar.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Say it to Maya <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 11 11 5M6 5h5v5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 14px; font: 650 0.875rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1d130a; background: #e8a85c; border: 1px solid #e8a85c; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: #fff; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { opacity: 0.12; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a85c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: Sunken ink well for messages and tasks; amber edge only while focused.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-textarea" rows="3" placeholder="Hi Maya, what are you doing today?"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 84px; resize: vertical; padding: 11px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #e7efea; background: #0b1311; border: 1px solid #30463f; border-radius: 10px; caret-color: #e8a85c; } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: #a1b4aa; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a85c; outline-offset: 0; border-color: #e8a85c; }

components.name: Sidecar Tabs
components.description: Equal-width tabs; the active tab grows an amber underline from the centre.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #23332e; background: #121c19; } .ds-tab { position: relative; flex: 1; min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; background: none; color: #a1b4aa; font: 400 0.8125rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 12%; right: 12%; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: #e8a85c; transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-tab.is-active { color: #e7efea; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab.is-active::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: #e7efea; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a85c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: District Chip
components.description: District name with its own data-supplied colour as a dot; active adds a tint.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; padding: 5px; background: rgb(14 23 20 / 0.9); border-radius: 13px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55), 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); } .ds-district { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 9px; font: 550 0.8125rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #b9c9c0; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-district::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--district-color, #7fd3a8); } .ds-district:hover { color: #e7efea; } .ds-district:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-district.is-active { color: #e7efea; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--district-color) 24%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--district-color) 45%, transparent); } .ds-district:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8a85c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: Request state pills; mint verified, caution blocked, coral failed.
components.html: In progress Completed Blocked Failed

components.name: Resident Portrait
components.description: Lit portrait plate: amber light pool, Georgia name, sans role and status.
components.css: .ds-profile { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px; min-height: 124px; padding: 10px 14px 12px 6px; border-radius: 16px; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 70% at 22% 85%, rgb(232 168 92 / 0.22), transparent 70%), #182521; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-portrait { width: 86px; height: 100px; flex: none; } .ds-profile h2 { margin: 0; font: 400 1.875rem/1.05 Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #e7efea; } .ds-role { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #a1b4aa; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-profile p { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #b9c9c0; }

narrative.overview:
The town is the only light source. Everything around it is evening darkness in a dusk-green register, and the isometric town sits on a rounded stage like a lamplit diorama on a dark shelf: a radial pool of light at its centre, a vignette that lets its edges fall away. The chrome never competes with it. Panels are barely-lifted shades of the same dark, text is cool and quiet, and colour is spent almost entirely on light: warm lantern amber for the clock, the one action you should take next, and the selected resident; cool mint for anything verified, live, or healthy.

Density is operational rather than decorative. The page is a working instrument for watching agents: one fluid world column (heading, stage, footer), a fixed resident sidecar beside it, and the depth (requests, community, event log, tools) waiting underneath without competing. Figures are tabular, data sits in a mono face, and the two moments of personality in type are the Georgia clock and the Georgia resident name, the two things in the interface that are about time and people.

Motion is sparse and physical. The page has one signature moment, the stage lighting up once the artwork has loaded; after that, values snap and leave a short afterglow instead of tweening, buttons compress under the press, and hover exists only for fine pointers. Rejected by the chosen direction: the pale dashboard with the game shrunk to one tile among many.
keyCharacteristics: Dusk-green darkness around a single lit stage; the stage is the brightest thing on the page.
Amber is light, not ink: fills, text, rings, and radial pools, never a stroke on chrome.
Mint is reserved for verified, live, and healthy states.
System sans for the interface; Georgia only for the clock and resident names; mono only for data.
Resting surfaces are flat and bordered; only floating surfaces cast shadows.
One lighting-up moment on load, then snap-and-afterglow.

rules.name: The Single Light Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only warm light in the chrome and there is one amber action per region. If two amber fills compete in the same panel, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Mint Means Proven Rule
rules.body: Mint appears only where the world has confirmed something: a completed step, a live connection, a healthy need. It is never decoration.

rules.name: The District Hue Rule
rules.body: District colours come from layout data (set per chip as `--district-color`) and appear only as an 8px dot, or as a 24% tint with a 45% edge when the district is active. They are never hard-coded into the stylesheet.

rules.name: The Two Serifs Rule
rules.body: Georgia is used in exactly two places: the clock and the resident's name. Headings, buttons, and labels stay in the system sans.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Cascadia Mono marks machine values (timestamps, scores, JSON). Human prose never goes mono, and running counts use tabular figures in the sans instead.

rules.name: The World First Rule
rules.body: The stage owns the first viewport at every width; depth content always starts below it, never beside it.

rules.name: The Rest Or Float Rule
rules.body: A resting surface has a 1px border and no shadow; a floating surface has a shadow and no border. Never both.

rules.name: The Clear Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass over the live canvas is a 90% opaque dusk fill (rgb(14 23 20 / 0.9)), never a backdrop blur; the town under it keeps moving and stays sharp.

dos: **Do** keep the stage the brightest thing on screen; chrome steps only from ink (#0b1311) to raise-2 (#1f2e29).
**Do** spend amber on light: one primary fill per region, the clock, timestamps, the active underline, focus, and the selected ring.
**Do** reserve mint for states the world has verified (completed steps, live connection, need levels).
**Do** give resting surfaces a 1px hairline and no shadow, and floating surfaces the float shadow and no border.
**Do** animate only transform and opacity, on the ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); gate hover behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
**Do** keep reduced-motion users' state legible: keep opacity changes, drop scale and translation.
**Do** grow every control to 44px on coarse pointers.
**Do** let district hues come from data, as dots and tints only.
donts: **Don't** use Georgia anywhere except the clock and the resident name.
**Don't** set prose, headings, or buttons in mono; mono is for timestamps, metadata, and JSON.
**Don't** use amber as a border or divider colour on chrome; amber is light, not a line.
**Don't** put coloured box-shadow halos on chrome; the only coloured glows are the radial light pools of the stage, the portrait, and the request afterglow.
**Don't** blur what sits over the live canvas; glass is an opaque dusk fill.
**Don't** add eyebrow kickers or tracked uppercase labels above headings; uppercase tracking is kept for the connection-status pill and memory kind labels.
**Don't** tween changing numbers or colours; snap them and let the afterglow mark the change.
**Don't** shrink the town into one tile among many dashboard panels.
